we introduce a novel computational source extraction technique, SID that extends light field microscopy (LFMs) to the mammalian brain and enables high resolution volumetric imaging in deep brain regions at high acquisition rates.

we introduce a novel computational source extraction technique, seeded iterative demixings, that can be applied to the light field microscopy modality to enable fast volumetric Ca2 + imaging in mammalian brains, and that the technique has been applied to the mouse cortex and hippocampus in vivo.
we developed a computational source extraction method that enables light field microscopy for high-speed volumetric calcium imaging in mammalian cortex.

the development of new computational methods for volumetric imaging.
